ops.title: review-v1.db exact-schema wedge: root cause + surgical heal (2026-07-25)
ops.body:
Machine: yasyf's laptop. The review store at ~/.claude/state/review/review-v1.db was initialized by a pre-attestation exact-v1 build: user_version=1 but no cc_transcript_schema_v1 marker table (23/24 objects), plus one textual DDL drift (candidates.generation carried DEFAULT 1; canonical v1 has none). The hard-cut validator (cc-transcript rust/crates/core/src/schema.rs, validate_objects) rejects with no migration path, so 'capt-hook review status' died and SessionStart announce_pr_status failed silently on every dispatch (~52 swallowed sqlite3.DatabaseError lines in capt-hookd.log).

Heal (data-preserving, validator-proven):
1. sqlite3 .backup, move live DB aside.
2. Run 'capt-hook review status' from a git repo cwd to mint a fresh canonical DB.
3. Graft the marker table CREATE + attestation row (identity captain-hook-review, ddl/object fingerprints) from fresh into live, byte-exact.
4. Patch candidates' sqlite_master sql text to canonical via PRAGMA writable_schema (DEFAULT drop is text-only; no row-format change). integrity_check ok.
5. Swap back; validator green; 77 candidates / 10 verdicts / 82 feedback events preserved; SessionStart dispatch clean.

Backups: ~/.claude/state/review/review-v1.db.bak-pre-marker (pre-heal), review-v1.db.fresh-mint (canonical reference). Any fleet machine whose review DB predates the attestation commits (51a0ffa/a9bb606/3b5793b, first released v12.17.0) is wedged the same way; same recipe applies. Side observation: review judge failing with spawnllm BackendUnavailable (no authenticated LLM backend) in the daemon context — unrelated to this wedge.
